energy-balance/1.formula: sum over t of w_generators[t] x sum of max(p[t], 0) over generators other than VoLL slacks and process shortfall
energy-balance/1.validity: verified solve (else unverified_solve); every bus balances and served demand is not negative, else balance_not_established. Refusals: legacy_lost_load_capture, misaligned_source, network_scope_required, non_energy_bus, shortfall_without_load, unsupported_snapshot_scope, unsupported_storage_inflow
